title: FastAFD: When Does Attention-FFN Disaggregation Pay on Rack-Scale NVLink?
abstract: arXiv:2611.07149v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Attention-FFN disaggregation (AFD) separates attention from the experts of a mixture-of-experts (MoE) model and has been reported to raise decode throughput over colocated serving. Whether this advantage holds on rack-scale NVLink systems such as GB200 NVL72 remains unclear: prior results were obtained on other hardware, against narrower colocated baselines, or with analytical models, whereas production engines serve large MoE models on these systems with wide expert parallelism (wide EP). We build and tune FastAFD, an AFD engine for GB200 NVL72 that overlaps the MoE of one microbatch with the attention of the other, and compare it against the best vLLM wide EP setting. Experiments show that AFD has a throughput advantage of up to 1.17x over wide EP on Qwen3 and 1.16x on Qwen3.5, and matches it on MiniMax-M2.5. translated_title: FastAFD：注意力-FFN分离在机架级NVLink上何时能带来收益？
translated_abstract: 注意力-FFN分离（AFD）将混合专家（MoE）模型中的注意力计算与专家部分分开部署，据报道可提升解码吞吐量（相比共置部署方式）。然而这一优势在GB200 NVL72等机架级NVLink系统上是否依然成立尚不清楚：此前的研究结果要么是在其他硬件上获得的，要么是针对较窄的共置基线，要么基于分析模型，而生产引擎则是在这些系统上采用宽专家并行来服务大型MoE模型。我们构建并调优了FastAFD，这是一个面向GB200 NVL72的AFD引擎，它将一个微批次的MoE计算与另一个微批次的注意力计算重叠执行，并将其与最优的vLLM宽EP设置进行比较。实验表明，AFD在Qwen3上相比宽EP具有高达1.17倍的吞吐量优势，在Qwen3.5上为1.16倍，在MiniMax-M2.5上则与之持平。我们推导了一个分析模型，仅使用共置vLLM的性能剖析数据即可在3%误差范围内预测AFD的吞吐量，从而判断是否值得采用分离部署。
tldr: 本文构建了面向GB200 NVL72机架级NVLink系统的FastAFD引擎，通过在微批次间重叠MoE与注意力计算，实现了相比最优vLLM宽EP设置高达1.17倍的解码吞吐量提升，并提出了一个仅凭共置vLLM剖析数据即可在3%误差内预测AFD收益的分析模型。
en_tdlr: FastAFD, an AFD engine for rack-scale NVLink systems (GB200 NVL72) that overlaps MoE computation of one microbatch with attention of another, achieves up to 1.17x decode throughput over the best vLLM wide EP setting, accompanied by an analytical model that predicts AFD throughput within 3% using only colocated vLLM profiles.
